title: Robbery of Banco Borges & Irmão, in Monte dos Burgos, Porto, November 4, 1977
summary: Wikidata item Q117768823, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "robbery carried out by 5 members of the PRP-BR, with 400,000$00 stolen". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
